blockers: unresolved:verify-01:Misattribution. The linked Yahoo page (S55) is a Wealth of Geeks article by Marija Mrakovic syndicated on Yahoo: its schema.org provider is 'Wealth of Geeks' and it shows the Wealth of Geeks logo. It cites PEOPLE only for other items (the wigs, the May social-media interview). The campaign line itself ('according to Variety') is relayed accurately, but the article names the wrong outlet in reader-facing text, and the evidence record's S55 speaker ('Yahoo/People syndication') carries the same error.
